//: NUIKA database rules. Paste into Firebase Console -> Realtime Database -> Rules -> Publish. Apply ONLY after the auth-aware app code is live and Noy's uid is listed under nuika/admins. See SECURITY.md.

nuika.//: Read at this level so the app can check whether the tree has been seeded. Nothing sensitive lives directly here; orders and kitchen carry their own denials below, and those cannot be widened by a parent grant.

admins.//: Written by hand in the console, never by the app. Each key is a Firebase Auth uid.

products.//: The menu is public. Only an admin may change it.

settings.//: Opening hours, deadline and payment links are public; only an admin sets them.

events.//: Noy's events board. Public read — events.html shows it to anyone, with no sign-in. Admin write only. Every field is typed for the same reason orders are: Noy's own text lands in the admin panel through innerHTML, and an untyped field is an injection route into a page holding a live database handle.

$eventId.//image: A flyer for the event, held as a data URL. The admin shrinks every picture to 1000px on its longest side and re-encodes it as JPEG before it is ever sent, so a phone photo arrives here at roughly 150KB rather than 4MB. Two things are pinned: it must BEGIN with data:image/, which is what stops an http(s) or javascript: value being stored in a field that reaches an , and it must fit inside 600,000 characters, which is about 440KB of base64 and comfortably above anything the resize can produce. events.html reads this whole node in one go, so every byte here is paid for by every visitor to the board.

stockUsed.//: Per-cycle tally so customers see remaining stock without reading anyone's order. Admin write sits at THIS level so a whole cycle can be recomputed. A customer may only raise a single counter — never lower it, never delete it.

$productId..validate: newData.isNumber() && newData.val() >= 0 && newData.val() <= 100000 && (!data.exists() || newData.val() > data.val() || root.child('nuika/admins').child(auth.uid).val() === true)

orders.//: Customer names, phone numbers and addresses. Readable ONLY by an admin. A customer may create one order and may not read, edit, overwrite or delete any order, including their own. Every field is typed: an untyped field is an HTML injection route into the admin panel.

kitchen.//: Recipes, supplier prices and margins. Noy's business data, not public.

finance.//: Expenses and invoice photos. Accounting data — admin only, never public. Entries and photos are separate nodes on purpose: the list must load without pulling every invoice image with it.

photos.//: One compressed JPEG data URL per entry, capped so a single invoice cannot bloat the node.

_seeded.//: One-time seed marker. Public read so the app can tell a fresh database from a deliberately emptied one. Create it by hand in the console at rollout; admin-only thereafter.
